title: Staged Title-Delay Chargeback Percentages — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Forty percent, seventy percent, or the grade's own percentage: a **Trade-In Agreements** title-delay chargeback percentage is staged by the length of the chargeback clock, the calendar days from the date the chargeback clock runs from to the day the chargeback is booked.

| Chargeback clock | Chargeback percentage |
|---|---|
| No more than 52 days | 40 percent |
| More than 52 days but no more than 75 days | 70 percent |
| More than 75 days | The grade's title delay chargeback percentage |

## Stage boundaries

| Clock | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 52 days | 40 percent |
| 53 days | 70 percent |
| 75 days | 70 percent |
| 76 days | The grade's title delay chargeback percentage |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A chargeback booked when the clock stands at 60 days is figured at 70 percent: on an amount of $8000.00 that is $5600.00. Booked at a clock of 45 days, it is figured at 40 percent, $3200.00.
